name: Hon Bay Canh
kicker: A turtle islet, not a second place
summary: Boat about 45 minutes to the islet the English page calls the largest nesting beach. The frame is the hill, the water, and a rocky shore. The long beach is not obvious, and a second photograph of the islet was not found. Time ashore, the fare, and nesting months are Check on arrival.
fee: 60,000 VND scenic fee, plus the boat
getThere: About 45 minutes by boat. The fare is Check on arrival.
heroCaption: Hòn Bảy Cạnh from the water: the hill and a rocky shore. The long beach is not obvious in this frame.
hours: Night viewing, when booked, is 18:00–06:00. Nesting months are Check on arrival.
closed: No weekly closing day was printed. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: Adult scenic fee 60,000 VND on route 2 or 3 in the 2022 reprint. The 2017 night guide, 350,000–600,000 VND by group size, is extra if a ranger leads, and half if no turtle is seen. The boat fare was not printed. Check the boat on arrival. The council PDF was not opened.
gettingThere: The English tour page says about 45 minutes by boat from the tourism jetty and does not give a street. Time on the islet is Check on arrival.

The August 2025 notice also allows the night at Bãi Dương, Hòn Cau, Hòn Tài, Hòn Tre Lớn, and Bãi Đất Thắm. Those are not separate place pages. Cap 50 people at one site, in at most five groups of about 10. Outside guides do not give their own talk.
